objective: Independent overfitting audit of fixed C6 and planned C7 deltas; exclude the entire narrowly selected lattice shortcut and the positive-radius sampling heuristic without broadening mathematical applicability.

overall_assessment.selection_bias: Multiple optimizations were chosen after inspecting public failures. Universal mathematical predicates make them sound on a stated class but do not remove this development selection bias or establish future distribution benefit.
overall_assessment.classification: Adopt supported general mathematical/engineering transformations; exclude the entire development-shaped lattice segment shortcut and positive-radius projection/bracket sampler; withhold unseen performance claims until fixed unused evaluation.
overall_assessment.important_distinction: Universal within a narrow class is not broad empirical generalization. Rename, positive scale, equation-unit and variable-order variants test invariance; they are dependent observations and are not counted as independent unseen problems.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: One real coordinate; two original integer-valued scalar expressions have rational squared polynomials of degree at most two and a nonzero integral constant difference N. Factor (m-n)(m+n)=N and enumerate all possible squared integer lengths.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: The finite-factor argument quantifies over arbitrary N and rational polynomial coefficients. No target value or benchmark geometry is inserted. Identity/zero difference, overflow, collapsed seeds and unprovable root boxes decline the shortcut; original constraints and independent verification still apply.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Four distinct offset pairs change divisor/parity/root patterns, with an independent finite integer-length oracle. Rename/unit variants are invariance checks, not additional independent families. Separate adversarial tests cover equal squares, vanishing multipliers, unstable quadratic roots, identity equations, unrepresentable roots and incomplete provenance.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: The 10^12 magnitude cap, 128-root cap and 80-digit seed arithmetic are engineering work limits with fallback, not mathematical acceptance thresholds. Their optimality and population speed/success benefit have not been established by an unused evaluation set.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Four direct integer point coordinates, two arbitrary rational anchors A,D, original AB parallel CD and |BC|=|AD|, with a target made only from slopes of the parallel sides and scalar arithmetic. Integer BC displacements lie on a finite norm circle; each nonzero AD-BC direction fixes the target slope.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: Finite displacement enumeration and integer-line consistency are exact statements for arbitrary admissible anchors and squared norms. Zero direction is kept unresolved unless an original exact guard proves impossibility. Noninvariant targets decline. Full original validation remains necessary.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Four distinct anchor vectors/norms are checked against a separately exhausted displacement/slope oracle. Tests include a genuine unrestricted parallelogram, noninvariant targets, rational anchor inconsistency, nonzero normalized-Parallel RHS, decimal anchors, and numeric-completion provenance. Translation/rename variants do not establish population generalization.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: This is a narrow mathematical family selected after public failures; universality within the family does not make its incidence in future workloads known. The 10^6 norm cap is a resource fallback. One unit witness is not proof that an unresolved displacement is impossible.
feature_audits.mathematical_status: The finite displacement and integer-line arguments are sound within the recognized class; this is not evidence of utility on unseen geometry.
feature_audits.production_policy: Exclude the entire end-to-end lattice-segment shortcut in every public run_search mode. Dormant helper retained only as an isolated mathematical experiment pending parent cleanup.
feature_audits.independent_empirical_evidence: One development geometry family motivated the recognizer. Translation, equation units, coordinate order and integer norm variants of the same template do not establish broader unseen utility.
feature_audits.reconsideration_policy: Do not reactivate or expand this experiment using the pending final unused-set or 323x3 results.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Previous witnesses sampled multipliers (-1,2,-2,3,-4,5,-16,17,-256,257) and offsets (0,-1,1) along each integer line.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: No theorem privileges these placements and the reviewed evidence contains no independent ablation justifying this particular list. Guard validation made emitted witnesses sound, but did not justify choosing the list as a general performance improvement.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: The positive fixtures reuse one trapezoid construction with altered anchor vectors, translations and expression representation. They do not independently compare placement schedules or cover guards requiring remote witnesses.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: Removed from the strict candidate. Each exact integer-line plan now submits origin+primitive_step once. If original guards reject it, the displacement stays partial and the ordinary backend runs. A new remote-guard test verifies candidate/ledger/failure-count preservation even when no unit witness is admissible.
feature_audits.production_policy: Whole lattice segment path is disabled, not only this multiplier list. The dormant helper has one canonical origin+primitive-step witness per displacement.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Typed homogeneous expressions under every t>0; all construction domains/equalities/guards are equivariant; target has degree zero; an original directly positive coordinate supplies the representative coordinate=1.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: Positive scaling is a group-orbit normalization for an infinite class, not a normalization to a known answer. Exact numeric tokens, primitive arities/types and selector domains must pass. Original search is always retained and chart points are untrusted proposals.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Original positive tests have two principal geometric constructions, many rename/unit variants, and three circle-offset coefficients. Negative tests change homogeneity, target dimension, integer constraints, bounds, selectors and supported primitive degrees. C7 adds one genuinely different triangular scalar-system reconstruction family; its 24 variants are still one family, not 24 independent problems.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: The two original positive geometric families were public-failure shaped. Passing them does not establish broad accuracy or speed benefit. The 1.5-second request allowance and algebraic eligibility limits must remain frozen for the unused evaluation; no per-case scale is selected.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Line-circle contact with independently proven shared incidence gives a radius-direction dot equation; circle-circle shared incidence gives a necessary collinear-radii equation. Segment incidence implies zero oriented area. Original domains and final verifier remain mandatory.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: These are universally quantified geometric consequences on their stated nondegenerate domains. Construction/equality proof routes, arbitrary coordinates/radii and exact source literals determine applicability; no expected scalar result does. Coincident-circle false branches can affect convergence but cannot bypass original tangency verification.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Tests exercise constructed circumcircle endpoints, explicit OnCircle/distance incidence, line/circle versus circle/circle topology, intersection-derived contact, unrelated radius/contact rejection and exact-decimal near misses. Some refinement positives differ only by scale and names; they are not broad numerical-stability measurements.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: The identities have mathematical support, but speed and convergence gains across a future workload are still hypotheses. Original inequalities/domain gates cannot be discarded in favor of the simpler residuals.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Original Circle(B+r*v,r) requires r>0; B is a proven vertex of an independent circumcircle (O,R); original internal-gap equality |B+r*v-O|=R-r yields r[2((B-O).v+R)+r(v.v-1)]=0.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: Division by r is justified by the original strict Circle domain. The bracket equation is necessary for arbitrary B,v,R meeting the proof conditions; all original residuals remain. No preferred numeric angle, radius or target enters the transformation.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Positive examples chiefly reuse B=(2s,0), v=(-2,q), with scale/rename variants and an extra q^2=2 equation. Negative tests cover nonaffinity, off-circle base, zero radius, wrong circle primitive, outer radius dependence, absent gap and exact-literal mismatch. This supports guarded algebraic soundness more than empirical class-wide convergence.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: Keep the mathematical equation. Do not infer the default sampler is justified merely because this equation is valid, or count scaled copies as independent performance evidence.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Previous default sampler projected probe and 32 affine-interior points onto radius closures, then used at most 32 scalar brackets when one coordinate remained.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: Projection -A/B and a sign-changing bracket are general numerical ideas, but the reviewed positive evidence is concentrated in the same radius-affine construction. There is no unused structural-family or independent ablation evidence for this particular sampler composition.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Scale/name/extra-equation variants reuse v=(-2,q) and one outer circle arrangement. They cannot establish general utility of 32 points, 32 attempts, 64 Brent iterations, the 1e-10 row suppression or 1e-13 tolerances.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: Removed from the production default portfolio without altering the necessary contact equations. Dormant implementation and its explicit unit tests remain available for source history; ordinary production probing no longer imports or runs it.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: No free coordinates; supported exact Cartesian geometry produces a bounded constant expression as an untrusted exact-identification proposal.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: Applicability is constancy and supported primitive semantics, not a finite answer dictionary. The original full verifier and higher-precision independent confirmation precede identification; the hint must lie within the confirmed original numeric error interval.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Positive tests mostly vary one composite triangle-area plus circle-area construction by rotation/translation/scale/rename. Wrong-hint rejection, decimal preservation, unsupported/nonconstant targets and deadline behavior are independent contract checks, not broad primitive/performance coverage.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: Adopt the verified proposal mechanism; its net workload performance is only a hypothesis until frozen unused evaluation. The 0.25-second inner and 1.5-second outer allowances are generic work limits, not justified optimal parameters.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Exact finite rational affine alternatives guide local proposals; affine inequality polytopes guide untrusted interior samples. Every original residual, nonlinear guard and domain is re-evaluated.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: The applicability predicates are standard logical-affine classes. Local LP/search limits decline or stop proposals while original candidates/backend remain; no problem name or special numeric root is selected.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Tests include different coefficient signs/shifts, variable order, coordinate aliases, contradictions, coupled all-different comparisons, nonlinear unsupported forms, narrow interiors and extreme units. Rename/unit variants remain dependent observations.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: Counts/budgets (32 points, 256 assignments, bounded starts/iterations and LP allowance) are heuristic resource choices. Correctness tests do not prove that the choices improve the future workload median or success rate.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Exact polynomial discovery is constrained by dimensions/degrees/root/operation limits; warm Newton applies to a generic feasible noninteger overdetermined system.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: The algebraic transformations and ordinary verification have mathematical contracts. Specific work caps and warm-start iteration counts control effort rather than characterize a reference answer.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Existing generic polynomial, singular/repeated root, branch-provenance, precision and deadline tests support semantics. They do not supply independent tuning/ablation evidence for every resource cap.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: Public-case-driven increases such as the active-variable limit must not be described as generalization evidence. Keep the fixed planned settings; do not retune after observing the unused set. Workload performance claims remain unproven.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: At four exact reconstruction sites, replacement expressions depend only on unchanged active coordinates or the unchanged univariate parameter; simultaneous xreplace therefore equals the previous substitutions.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: This is an expression-reconstruction optimization keyed by symbols, not coefficients, target descriptors, geometric templates or benchmark identifiers. No mathematical applicability expansion or precision reduction is introduced.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: The triangular reconstruction fixture is structurally different from the original two scale-chart geometries and checks all variable orders, but its 24 variants are one mathematical family. Existing algebraic regressions provide additional semantic coverage.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: One-workload timing samples are insufficient for a corpus-wide speed claim. Adopt semantic equivalence; assess net performance only on the frozen candidate.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Charge optional symbolic work to process CPU with the existing 0.5 CPU-second allowance, keep the parent 1.5-second wall deadline and solve deadline, and decline if another CPU timer owns the facility.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: The rule applies to every optional symbolic request and separates scheduler contention from actual computation. It does not add work based on an instance or weaken branch/domain verification.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Timer tests independently distinguish idle time, busy CPU, wall alarms and existing timer ownership. Contention timing uses a controlled competitor but a single workload, so it supports the accounting mechanism rather than population performance.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: This changes the resource policy under contention and is platform-dependent. Unsupported timer platforms retain fallback. Do not claim general workload benefit from the contention example alone.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Any nondeadline optional derivative compilation rejection returns to the original numerical Jacobian; genuine solve TimeoutError continues to propagate.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: The counterexample is an elementary linear system with a legal scalar-alias chain. The fix adds no geometry class, case-specific predicate, iteration allowance or approximation.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: New tests cover direct and real-worker recursion rejection, several compiler exception types, fallback convergence of the original equations, unsupported-plan caching and global-deadline propagation.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: This is a generic regression repair. It does not establish a new performance improvement and should not be counted as success on an unseen mathematical family.

feature_audits.mathematical_or_engineering_class: Import deferral, identical-coordinate/precision/schedule memoization and equivalent high-precision arithmetic backend apply uniformly, independently of problem structure.
feature_audits.generalization_grounding: No benchmark-conditioned dispatch or low-precision substitution was found. Exact cache keys and replayed construction/branch evidence preserve the original checks; independent confirmation uses its own precision schedule.
feature_audits.test_diversity_audit: Cache tests include near coordinates, different precisions/schedules, selector evidence, failed/expired work and unrelated invalid construction. Those are independent implementation contracts rather than public target replicas.
feature_audits.limits_and_unproven_claims: Correctness/regression evidence supports the mechanism. Fresh-process startup and whole-corpus performance remain for the frozen evaluation, not inferred from microbenchmarks alone.
